claims.claim: Swish containment is exactly a multiplicity-respecting directed-cycle problem.
claims.evidence: Orient every selected physical card from its transformed hoop position to its transformed ball position. The swish condition says that every used vertex has indegree and outdegree exactly one, so every nonempty connected component is a directed simple cycle. Conversely, the cards realizing any directed simple cycle put exactly one hoop and one ball at every cycle vertex and nothing elsewhere. A component of any larger swish is itself a swish, and treating copies as separately consumable cards enforces multiplicity exactly.
claims.witness: The constructive equivalence maps a swish component to its directed cycle and maps any cycle back to the distinct physical card copies labeling its arcs.
claims.search_method: Direct proof from the authorized definition, supplemented by exact enumeration of every allowed transformed arc.

claims.claim: A no-swish collection contains at most 20 distinct transformation types, and this is sharp.
claims.evidence: Exact enumeration gives position-orbit sizes 4,2,4,2; 36 card types; eight internal types partitioned 3,1,3,1; and 28 cross-orbit types partitioned into 14 reversal pairs. A no-swish support contains at most one member of each reversal pair, at most two members of either internal triple, and at most one internal singleton, giving 14+2+1+2+1=20. Each forbidden pair makes a directed 2-cycle, while each complete internal triple makes a directed triangle. The checker also verifies a 20-type cycle-free construction, proving sharpness.
claims.witness: Order the position orbits A<B<C<D, take all 14 cross types directed forward, and take internal representatives (1,1)->(1,3), (1,1)->(4,1), (1,2)->(4,2), (2,1)->(2,3), (2,1)->(3,1), and (2,2)->(3,2), one copy each.
claims.search_method: Direct obstruction proof plus exhaustive integer-state cycle search for all local obstructions and the sharp construction.

claims.claim: Unless all eight internal types are duplicated, the usual once-or-twice interpretation of the 60-card deck already yields a 29-card no-swish subset.
claims.evidence: Under the claim's stated once-or-twice interpretation, all 36 types occur with multiplicity one or two. If some internal type is not doubled, the eight internal types account for M0<=15 physical cards, leaving at least 45 cross cards. For each of the 24 orders of the four position orbits, select the six safe internal types and every physical cross card directed forward. This is cycle-free. Every cross card is forward in exactly 12 orders, so the average selected cross count is (60-M0)/2>=45/2; an integral maximum is therefore at least 23, giving at least 29 cards total. The qualifier is essential: this does not establish that the authorized input itself specifies the actual deck's multiplicities.
claims.witness: The exact checker enumerates all 24 orders, verifies incidence 12 for every cross type, and verifies multiplicity-respecting acyclicity of a boundary M0=15 construction.
claims.search_method: Exact double-counting proof and enumeration of the 24 orbit orders using integer counts only.

claims.claim: The authorized input omits information essential to deciding the exact commercial-deck target.
claims.evidence: The authorized source gives 60 cards and 36 transformation types but no identities of duplicated types. Two multiplicity vectors consistent with those aggregate facts have opposite answers. Deck X doubles all eight internal types and both directions in eight reversal pairs. Any no-swish subset then has at most 6+8*2+6=28 cards, and the forward construction attains 28. Deck Y doubles nine forward cross types, all 14 reverse cross types, and one internal type; selecting two copies of those nine forward types, one of each other forward type, and the six safe internal cards gives a verified 29-card no-swish subset. Thus the supplied aggregate information cannot determine the requested commercial-deck answer.
claims.witness: Deck X and Deck Y are explicitly generated by the checker as 60-card, 36-type once-or-twice decks; it verifies a 28-card witness for X, the matching upper bound for X, and a 29-card no-swish witness for Y.
claims.search_method: Constructive indistinguishability argument plus exact enumeration and multiplicity-respecting directed-cycle checks.

target_evidence: The exact target asks for a decision about the original physical 60-card deck: either prove every 29-card subset contains a swish or exhibit a larger no-swish subset. The draft does neither because the authorized input lacks the deck's type-multiplicity vector. Its verified cycle formulation, sharp 20-type support bound, conditional 29-card theorem, and proof of input insufficiency are material but incomplete progress, so VALID_PARTIAL_PROGRESS is appropriate. The draft labels itself PARTIAL and explicitly disclaims full resolution; that claimed resolution is ACCURATE, not overstated or understated.
checks_performed: Read only the specified source JSON and draft JSON; used no web, retrieval database, treatment material, prior run, report, or other solution.
